one_liner: Portland's minutes leader, Toumani Camara, posts a 21.4 PRA-per-36 rate -- the lowest top-contributor box rate in this manifest.
three_things: 21.4 PRA per 36 from the team's most-used player is the league floor here.
He still logged 6,778.4 minutes, so the low rate is about role, not playing time.
The team scored 115.3 per game on a fast 103.8 pace proxy.
context_note: The 'top contributor' is the player with the most total minutes for that team across the 3-season sample, not necessarily its best or highest-scoring player. PRA-per-36 sums points, rebounds, and assists per 36 minutes -- a raw box rate, not an impact metric. ppg_latest_season and pace_proxy_latest_season are single-season figures while games_total spans three seasons, and pace_proxy is a proxy, not official possession-based pace. The manifest is descriptive_only, with no schedule, opponent, or roster-continuity adjustment. League-wide rank statements were computed by sorting all 30 teams in this manifest on the named field; the underlying values are read verbatim. A low PRA rate from a minutes leader often indicates a defense-first role, which this box-only manifest cannot measure.
